key_findings.polarization_no_reduction: Diversity intervention did NOT reduce polarization (1.514 vs 1.462 control). The treatment actually showed 3.6% HIGHER polarization.
key_findings.reduced_variance: Treatment reduced stance variance by 9% (0.131 vs 0.144), suggesting agents adopted more similar stances
key_findings.agent4_anomaly: Agent 4 shows zero cross-viewpoint exposure AND zero stance_score across ALL records - indicates complete isolation from information flow
key_findings.limited_cross_exposure: Overall cross-viewpoint exposure is very low (~0.067) in both conditions - echo chamber effect present
key_findings.toxicity_zero: No toxicity observed in either condition (avg_toxicity = 0.0)
key_findings.treatmentFewerRecords: Treatment had 85 records vs 109 in control - possible early termination or different engagement patterns

agent_4.possible_interpretation: Agent may represent a 'disengaged' or 'radicalized' profile - either completely detached or only consuming ideologically pure content

agent_2.status: only agent showing positive stance evolution
agent_2.cross_viewpoint_exposure: low but slightly higher than others
